limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the zero comparison but removed the output register stage, making counts and set values visible one clock earlier, and changed the reset value of zero from low to high.

The passing test expected immediate output updates and a high zero flag during reset, so it validated the rewrite’s assumptions rather than checking that the original timing and reset behavior were preserved.

limitations.quote: A flag assigned in a clocked block using a nonblocking assignment samples the pre-edge value of the register it reads.
limitations.note: The agent read the relevant timing guidance but did not use it to recognize that number and zero already sampled the same pre-edge value of num, leaving only the comparison constant to fix.
